artifacts.summary: Research on dispatch-metrics.sh design: corrects the dispatch's stale transcript-path assumption against the live nested subagents/ layout, documents the exact cc_session_id + dispatch_seq transcript join, confirms the three measured traps, and grounds the postflight call-site wiring in the current (re-measured) orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh line numbers.

memory_candidates.content: Claude Code's live transcript layout for dispatched subagents (as of version 2.1.288) is nested, not flat: ~/.claude/projects/<slug>/<cc_session_id>/subagents/agent-<agentId>.jsonl with a sibling agent-<agentId>.meta.json carrying {agentType, description, toolUseId, spawnDepth, requestShape, requestNonInteractive}. <slug> is the cwd with every non-alphanumeric character replaced by '-'. This supersedes an older assumed flat sibling-file shape (~/.claude/projects/<slug>/agent-*.jsonl) seen in some task descriptions.

A dispatched subagent's transcript file (agent-<id>.jsonl) opens with a user-type line whose message.content is the literal dispatch prompt text, which embeds the exact Context JSON block verbatim (task_number, dispatch_seq, session_id, etc.). This gives an exact, unambiguous join from a postflight call site's own (task_number, dispatch_seq) to the correct subagents/agent-*.jsonl file, avoiding any nearest-timestamp or description-string heuristic.

$CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID is identical across the lead orchestrator session and every dispatched subagent's own bash tool calls within the same task tree -- it always names the top-level/lead session, never a per-subagent id. This is the same value events-log-lifecycle.sh independently captures into events.jsonl's cc_session_id field from hook stdin's top-level .session_id. A script run directly in the orchestrator's own bash process (e.g. orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh) can read this env var directly with zero extra I/O to get the join key to that session's transcript directory.
